protocols.title: AHK-Cu (50 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No validated injectable dose and no human trial. Vendor/community guides cluster around 100–200 mcg SC; only primary-source numerical figure is animal intradermal 100–500 mcg per 0.1 mL from a patent. 50 mg + 2 mL dilution is reference math.

schedule.description: Community/vendor range; no human trial or validated injectable dose. Separate animal patent describes intradermal 100–500 mcg per 0.1 mL.

regimen.notes: Dose range is not clinically validated. Do not conflate vendor convention with animal patent concentrations.
